day_line: A fertile field on a Pig day. Gentle and generous: good for home, food and caring for people, easy to overdo the treats.

lines.Yang Wood: Saturday chores save you money. Fix the dripping tap yourself, then treat yourself to lunch.
lines.Yin Wood: A lucky find turns up today. Check the sale price twice, then go for it.
lines.Yang Fire: Your words gather people today. Plan the family outing, and let others pick the food.
lines.Yin Fire: Easy fun is yours today. Bake, paint or play; anything that isn't a screen.
lines.Yang Earth: Someone has a different plan today. Meet halfway: brunch first, then theirs.
lines.Yin Earth: Kindred spirits nearby today. Invite a friend over to cook; share the washing up.
lines.Yang Metal: A helping hand comes today. Let family help with the big sort-out.
lines.Yin Metal: A slow morning brings clarity. Write the idea down before the day gets busy.
lines.Yang Water: A proper thank-you comes your way. Take it; you did a good thing this week.
lines.Yin Water: The to-do list feels heavy today. Do two things well and let the rest go.
